whoAmI.title: Who am I? Play online with friends
whoAmI.description: Everyone picks a character for someone else. You see their cards, never yours. Find out who you are with yes-or-no questions. Free, 2 to 4 players, no sign-up.
whoAmI.pitch: Everyone picks a character for someone else. Find out yours with yes-or-no questions.
whoAmI.imageAlt: Who am I? on 4Dare: cards on the table and a yes-or-no question

impostor.title: Impostor: play online with friends
impostor.description: Everyone gets the same character but one, who doesn't know they're the impostor. Answer questions about your card with a tap and vote out whoever stands out. Free, 3 to 10 players, no sign-up.
impostor.pitch: Everyone has the same character but one. Not even they know. Answer for your card and find who stands out.
impostor.imageAlt: Impostor on 4Dare: matching cards on the table and one that differs

whatFor.title: What for? Play online with friends
whatFor.description: A character auction where nobody knows what for. Then the envelope opens the mission, everyone builds and defends their board, and all vote for the best team. Free, 2 to 8 players, no sign-up.
whatFor.pitch: Buy your team at an auction without knowing what for. Then the envelope opens the mission.
whatFor.imageAlt: What for? on 4Dare: a chalkboard with photos and a sealed envelope
